title: Tiger Gorilla
tagline: Swing through the jungle canopy, grab the parrots and feed the hungry babies back at the nest, while the photographers prowl below and the crocodiles lurk in the pools.
blurb: Swing through the jungle canopy, grab the parrots and feed the hungry babies back at the nest, while the photographers prowl below and the crocodiles lurk in the pools. Twelve levels in three zones, a chilli-powered boost and a vanishing trick, all on the 128 with music. Nobody must see a thing!
controls: Left / right (walk, swing, along a branch)
Let go of a branch or vine; start
Kempston / Sinclair joystick (title): two taps to dash, fire + down to vanish

review.verdict: A swinging good time up in the canopy, with a few hairy moments on the ground. Go ape.

quote.text: I loved this from the very first swing

credits.name: Zippy Dee, Marjorie Plunkett and Norm Crabtree for INK & PAPER
